name: Dr. D. Kashinatham
verified_role: Consultant Urologist, Andrologist & Transplant (Kidney Transplant) Surgeon, Yashoda Hospitals, Malakpet, Hyderabad. verified_experience: 20 years (Yashoda official profile; a FAQ line on the same page also states 'over 16 years'). Qualifications: MS (General Surgery), MCh (Urology). Medical Council registration 42868. Reported 500+ renal transplant surgeries.

Prior academic roles: Assistant Professor of Urology at SVIMS and Senior Resident in Urology at NIMS Hyderabad. Maintains his own professional website.
